run_go_to_waypoint_with_goal: run the spot robot to navigate to a goal position specified as x,y,heading coordinates
run_go_to_waypoint_with_waypoint: run the spot robot to navigate to a named waypoint from the waypoint YAML configuration
run_go_to_waypoint_with_dock: run the spot robot to navigate to a goal and automatically dock after completion
run_go_to_waypoint_with_limit: run the spot robot to navigate to a goal with limited forward, horizontal, and angular velocity
review_main_function: review the main function that handles argument parsing, navigation commands, and robot shutdown
